description: This file defines the `PerformanceReviewDecorator` class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve data related to performance reviews, such as setting employees and job titles by ID, fetching reviewer roles, and formatting dates related to performance reviews.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for PerformanceReview entities, providing methods to manipulate review data and retrieve formatted information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a PerformanceReview object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee for the review based on employee number.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the job title for the review based on job title ID.

methods.name: getSupervisorReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer who is the supervisor.

methods.name: getEmployeeReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer who is the employee.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted due date of the performance review.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the review period.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the review period.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted completion date of the review.

methods.name: getStatusName
methods.description: Provides a human-readable name for the review status based on its ID.
